Solution

The Clinical Blind Spot

The Lethal Reflex: Dose Escalation for Missed Pills

  • The Trap: When clinic readings stay high, doctors reflexively double the dose. If the real cause was missed pills, escalating strength causes severe hypotension, bradycardia, or ICU admission when the patient resumes pills at home.
  • White-Coat Adherence: Patients take pills frantically 2 to 3 days before visits. Readings look normal today, concealing weeks of unmedicated gaps.
Clinical Risk: Fatal Outpatient Toxicity

Public GitHub: tanishkuvar11/Vanishing-Dose

Technical Implementation

Pipeline & Provenance

CMS Claims Pipeline & Rigorous Censoring

  • 8-Stage Python Pipeline: 116,352 real Medicare beneficiaries from CMS DE-SynPUF files. NDCs standardized to active ingredients via RxNorm.
  • Hospital Stay Censoring: Computes daily Proportion of Days Covered (PDC) while strictly censoring inpatient stays so institutional care is never mislabeled.
Real CMS Medicare Data Foundation
Safe AI Abstention

Split-Conformal Prediction: Zero Hallucination

  • Provable 90% Coverage: Distribution-free calibration with finite-sample guarantees (alpha = 0.10). Eliminates reckless guesses on sparse data.
  • Refusal to Predict: For sparse records (<4 refills), uncertainty bounds exceed +/- 35%. The AI safely withholds judgment and prompts doctor review.
  • EHR Standards: Built around HL7 FHIR US Core and CDS Hooks.
HL7 FHIR & CDS Hooks Compliant

Feasibility

Point-of-Care Fit

15-Second Doctor Workflow (Zero Extra Hardware)

  • Zero Dedicated Hardware: Uses patient-owned consumer smartwatches (Apple HealthKit, Google Health Connect) and real-time pharmacy benefit claims.
  • 15-Second Point-of-Care Actions: Operates directly in the EHR consultation window. One click defers dangerous escalations and auto-populates notes.
Zero Clinic Friction / Instant Adoption
Health Equity (SDG 3)

Non-Punitive Compassionate Support

  • Dismantling Patient Blame: Over 40% of missed refills stem from out-of-pocket costs and transport deserts. We replace scolding with practical aid.
  • 12-Month Execution Roadmap: Q1: 10k patient retrospective IRB; Q2: 500-patient clinic pilot; Q3: CE/FDA SaMD & Epic App Orchard launch.
Empathetic Care / High Patient Retention
